forbidden.name: no-executor-to-verticals
forbidden.comment: Executor CANNOT import from verticals - this violates vertical isolation

forbidden.name: no-executor-to-adapters
forbidden.comment: Executor CANNOT import from adapters - adapters are output-only

forbidden.name: no-adapters-to-executor
forbidden.comment: Adapters CANNOT import from executor - adapters are side-effect sinks only

forbidden.name: no-adapters-to-verticals
forbidden.comment: Adapters CANNOT import from verticals - adapters are reusable across verticals

forbidden.name: no-kernel-modifications
forbidden.comment: Kernel interface CANNOT be imported for modification - it is read-only

forbidden.name: no-forbidden-zones
forbidden.comment: NO files may exist in forbidden zones (utils, helpers, shared, common, lib)

forbidden.name: verticals-may-only-import-from-core
forbidden.comment: Verticals may only import from executor (types), adapters (registry), and kernel-client

forbidden.name: no-vertical-cross-imports
forbidden.comment: Verticals CANNOT import from other verticals - each vertical is isolated (except tests)
